test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Heena covers a certain distance by train at 110 km/h and she returned to the starting point covering the same distance, driving a car at 50 km/h. Find her average speed for the whole journey.
solution:
Given:

Speed = 110 km/h and returning speed = 50 km/h

Formula used:

Average speed = 2ab/(a + b)

Calculation:

a = 110 km/h, b = 50 km/h

According to the concept:

S = (2 x 110 x 50)/160

⇒ S = 68.75 km/h

∴ The average speed is 68.75 km/h.
